{{short description|American mathematician}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=March 2026}}
'''William Bigelow Easton''' is an American mathematician and computer scientist who proved [[Easton's theorem]] about the possible values of the [[continuum function]]. His advisor at Princeton was the mathematician and computer scientist [[Alonzo Church]].<ref>{{cite web |title=William Bigelow Easton |url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=8035 |website=Mathematics Genealogy Project |access-date=2 November 2022}}</ref>
As of 2026, he lives in [[Charlottesville, Virginia]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Peter Bigelow Easton, September 8, 1931-January 26, 2026|url=https://www.fullernaples.com/obituaries/Peter-Bigelow-Easton?obId=47106361}}</ref>
